# HabitFlow — Full Site Description for AI & LLMs

> Comprehensive documentation for HabitFlow — a premium editorial habit tracker.
> Site: https://habitflow.indevs.in/
> Last updated: 2026-07-29

---

## Overview

HabitFlow is a design-driven, editorial-style habit tracking web application. Unlike conventional habit trackers that rely on aggressive gamification, badges, and social competition, HabitFlow emphasizes calm, intentional tracking — built around the philosophy that **consistency is the only metric that matters**.

The app serves two audiences:
1. **Individual users** — anyone wanting to build and maintain daily habits with a beautiful, distraction-free interface
2. **Blog readers** — people seeking evidence-based guidance on habit formation, psychology, and productivity

---

## Product Details

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | HabitFlow |
| URL | https://habitflow.indevs.in/ |
| Type | Web Application (SPA + SSR) |
| Category | Lifestyle / Productivity / Habit Tracking |
| Price | Free (USD $0) |
| Authentication | JWT with HTTP-only cookies |
| API Backend | Node.js / Express.js / MongoDB |
| Author | Prashant Khuva |

### Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4
- **State Management:** Redux Toolkit
- **Animations:** Framer Motion, GSAP (ScrollTrigger)
- **Icons:** Lucide React
- **Forms:** React Hook Form
- **Charts:** Custom SVG (heatmap, weekly bar charts)
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB (Mongoose)
- **Deployment:** Vercel (frontend), Render (backend)

---

## Feature Details

### Habit Management
- Create unlimited habits with title, category, color, and frequency
- Two habit types: **Boolean** (done/not done) and **Streak** (count-based)
- Categories: Health, Fitness, Learning, Productivity, Mindfulness (each with distinct icons)
- Custom color assignment per habit
- Create, update, pause, resume, archive, and delete habits
- Active, archived, and completed views

### Tracking & Analytics
- **Weekly completion chart** — bar chart showing 7-day progress
- **Monthly heatmap** — visual grid showing daily completion across the month
- **Streak tracking** — current streak, longest streak, and streak history
- **Completion rate** — percentage of days completed over a period
- **Time-of-day insights** — distribution of completions across morning, afternoon, and evening
- **Rhythm journal** — reflection notes tied to each completed habit

### Reflection System
- Add notes and reflections after completing a habit
- Archive of past reflections with search
- Journal-style browsing of completed ritual entries

### User Interface
- Editorial design system with minimal aesthetic
- Fully responsive (mobile-first with bottom navigation)
- Smooth page transitions with Framer Motion
- GSAP scroll-triggered animations on landing page
- Swipe navigation between dashboard, rituals, and statistics
- Dark mode support with system preference detection
- Toast notification system for feedback
- Custom cursor on desktop
- Route loading progress indicator

### Authentication & Settings
- Email/password signup and signin
- Cookie-based JWT session management
- Profile editing (username, email)
- Password change
- Account deletion
- Admin guard for blog management

## FAQ

### What is HabitFlow?
HabitFlow is a premium editorial habit tracker that helps you build daily rituals, track streaks, visualize progress with heatmaps and charts, and maintain a reflection journal — all in a calm, distraction-free interface.

### Is HabitFlow free?
Yes, HabitFlow is completely free to use. Create unlimited habits, track streaks, view analytics, and write reflection notes at no cost.

### How does habit tracking work?
Create a habit with a title, category icon, color, and frequency (daily or weekly). Each day you complete it, mark it done and optionally add a reflection note. HabitFlow tracks your streak, weekly progress, and long-term consistency through heatmaps and charts.

### Can I track multiple habits?
Yes, you can create and track unlimited habits simultaneously. Each habit has its own tracking page with a calendar view, completion rate, and reflection log.

### What categories are available?
Health, Fitness, Learning, Productivity, and Mindfulness. Each has a distinct icon and you can assign a custom color.

### Does HabitFlow have a mobile app?
HabitFlow is a progressive web application optimized for mobile browsers. It works on any device with a modern browser and supports mobile-first navigation.

### How is my data protected?
Authentication uses JWT with HTTP-only cookies. The connection is encrypted via HTTPS. Passwords are hashed and stored securely on the backend.
